rationale: Raw httpx client feels more functional and lightweight, but accepts genai SDK.
Separate OOP classes for registry and prompter map cleanly to components.
GenAI SDK handles streaming and api key injection natively.
Declarative config settings for models and keys align with our Pydantic settings.
Allows dynamic mocking of GenAI client in tests.
Mocking external SDK calls is required for consistent, offline QA verification.
The google-genai library is standard and prevents us writing custom post serializers.
Selected separate modules with google-genai SDK and mocked client unit tests.
